_howto: Add a new entry to 'messages' each day. Copy a whole { ... } block, paste it, change the date and text. Every block needs a comma after it EXCEPT the last one. Keep the ] and } at the bottom.

messages.text: When I'm buried six feet under, and my soul gently rises toward the sky, the stars will look at it with jealousy, because it will shine brighter than all of them, lit by the boundless love it carried for you.
